name: Split
what_it_does: Each shot fires 2 bullets instead of 1 spread slightly apart. Every bullet does full damage and carries every on-hit effect. Still uses one round of ammo.
how_it_stacks: Each stack doubles the bullets (2 then 4 then 8). Cap 3 stacks.
built_up: Multiplies every on-hit effect
deliberate_weakness: Bullets fan into a spread: strong close and weaker at range; armor shrugs off weak bullets

name: Grow
what_it_does: Bullets are twice as big and hit 25% harder. Each shot takes 25% longer to charge before it fires.
how_it_stacks: Each stack adds another +25% damage and +25% charge time. Size doubles on the first stack. Cap 3 stacks.
with_one_stack: Bigger and harder-hitting bullets but slower to charge
built_up: Answer to armor; carries single-bullet builds
deliberate_weakness: Charge time cuts fire rate

name: Poison
what_it_does: Hits poison the enemy for 3 damage per second over 4 seconds. Bullets do 20% less direct damage.
how_it_stacks: Each stack adds 1 poison stack per hit. An enemy holds up to 5. Cap 3 stacks.
with_one_stack: Steady damage on anything you tag
built_up: Ticks on every Split bullet; feeds Exploit
deliberate_weakness: -20% direct damage for the ticks; regenerators out-heal slow stacks

name: Pierce
what_it_does: Bullets pass through 2 enemies. Each enemy passed takes 20% off the bullet's damage.
how_it_stacks: Each stack passes through 2 more enemies. Cap 3 stacks.
built_up: Each pierce re-triggers on-hit effects
deliberate_weakness: Loses 20% damage per enemy passed; little use against lone bosses

name: Quickdraw
what_it_does: Fire 25% faster (3.5 to about 4.4 shots per second). The magazine empties faster.
how_it_stacks: Each stack adds another +25% fire rate. Cap 4 stacks.
built_up: Feeds every-Nth triggers quickly
deliberate_weakness: Drains the magazine faster

name: Exploit
what_it_does: Bullets do 15% more damage to every enemy and 1.75 times damage to enemies with any debuff such as poison or chill.
how_it_stacks: Bonuses add per stack. Cap 2 stacks.
built_up: Multiplies damage on debuffed enemies
deliberate_weakness: Big bonus needs a state source

name: Shrapnel
what_it_does: Every hit explodes in a small blast (radius 40) for 40% of the bullet's damage.
how_it_stacks: Each stack widens the blast radius. Cap 2 stacks.
built_up: Every Split bullet explodes: swarm shredder
deliberate_weakness: Splash is weak vs armor

name: Chill
what_it_does: Hits slow the enemy to 60% speed for 3 seconds.
how_it_stacks: Each stack lengthens the slow. Cap 2 stacks.
built_up: Keeps debuff active for Exploit
deliberate_weakness: Little value without a payoff

name: Bloodshot
what_it_does: Fire 1 extra bullet for every 25 HP you currently have. At 100 HP that is 4 extra bullets.
built_up: Huge bullet count at high HP
deliberate_weakness: Shrinks as you take damage

name: Reclaimer
what_it_does: Every 6th bullet fired gives back one round of ammo.
how_it_stacks: Each stack lowers the count by 1 (6 then 5 then 4). Cap 3 stacks.
built_up: Near-infinite magazine at high fire rate
deliberate_weakness: Needs high bullet count to matter. Replaces Field Medic (heal removed)

name: Blast Ring
what_it_does: Every 5th bullet explodes around you (radius 90) for 120% damage to enemies and 8 damage to you.
how_it_stacks: Each stack lowers the count by 1. Cap 2 stacks.
built_up: Constant area control
deliberate_weakness: Hurts you 8 HP each proc

name: Shockwave
what_it_does: Every 4th bullet shoves all enemies within 160 away from you.
how_it_stacks: Each stack lowers the count by 1. Cap 3 stacks.
built_up: Near-permanent crowd control
deliberate_weakness: Rarely triggers at slow fire rate

name: Echo
pillars_supported: Synergy;Counterplay;Run arc;Alien and unusual;Power fantasy;Felt immediately;Draft tension
what_it_does: Every 4th hit spawns one extra bullet in a random direction. The extra bullet counts as fired and as a hit.
how_it_stacks: Each stack lowers the count by 1. Cap 2 stacks.
built_up: Self-feeding bullet loop
deliberate_weakness: Spawned bullets limited to generation 2; hard to balance

name: Zigzag
what_it_does: Bullets weave side to side and cross the same enemy twice. On-hit effects trigger on each crossing.
with_one_stack: Bullets weave and cross the same enemy twice
built_up: On-hit effects trigger twice per enemy
deliberate_weakness: Less precise aim; nothing alone

name: Ricochet
what_it_does: Bullets bounce once off walls or enemies and lose 15% damage per bounce.
how_it_stacks: Each stack adds 1 bounce. Cap 3 stacks.
built_up: Extra hits multiply on-hit effects
deliberate_weakness: Each bounce loses 15% damage; bounce paths are hard to predict

name: Volatile Core
what_it_does: Dead enemies explode in a fixed blast (radius 50).
with_one_stack: Kills pop a small fixed blast
built_up: Chain-kill explosions in swarms
deliberate_weakness: Fixed blast size to limit cost; explosion cap

name: Soul Snatcher
what_it_does: +5% damage as soon as you pick it then +0.1% damage for every enemy killed this run. Resets each run.
built_up: +0.1% damage per kill; huge by level 8
deliberate_weakness: Weak in boss fights; strong in swarms

name: Reaper
what_it_does: +10 max HP as soon as you pick it then +0.1% max HP per kill. Your current HP rises with it. Capped at +150%.
how_it_stacks: Not decided yet. Needs Soul Snatcher first.
built_up: +0.1% max HP per kill and heals with it
deliberate_weakness: Chained so it may never be drawn; capped

name: Gravity Seed
pillars_supported: Synergy;Counterplay;Readable;Alien and unusual;Power fantasy;Felt immediately;Draft tension
what_it_does: Hits pull nearby enemies toward the impact for about 2 seconds so they pack together.
built_up: Turns every explosion into a vacuum bomb
deliberate_weakness: Does little without an explosion

name: Shard Bloom
pillars_supported: Synergy;Readable;Run arc;Alien and unusual;Power fantasy;Felt immediately;Draft tension
what_it_does: Hits embed shards in the enemy. At 6 shards they all detonate together.
with_one_stack: Shards pile up on one enemy
built_up: Fast shard stacking with Split detonates targets
deliberate_weakness: Slow against fast swarms

name: Third Strike
pillars_supported: Synergy;Risk;Counterplay;Alien and unusual;Player skill;Felt immediately;Draft tension
what_it_does: Hit an enemy twice within 3 seconds and it is stunned. A third hit disintegrates it.
built_up: Third hit disintegrates a target
deliberate_weakness: Needs focus fire; weak vs swarms

name: Bond Arc
pillars_supported: Synergy;Counterplay;Readable;Alien and unusual;Power fantasy;Felt immediately;Draft tension
what_it_does: A hit links the enemy to the nearest other enemy with a beam. Damage and states such as poison and chill are shared along the link.
with_one_stack: Links two enemies with a beam
built_up: Shares poison and chill down the chain
deliberate_weakness: Needs a nearby second target

name: Twin Gate
pillars_supported: Synergy;Risk;Readable;Alien and unusual;Player skill;Felt immediately;Draft tension
what_it_does: The first two walls your bullets hit become a linked portal pair. Bullets and enemies that enter one come out of the other.
with_one_stack: First two walls become a portal pair
built_up: Bullets and enemies hop across the arena
deliberate_weakness: Expensive; schedule last

name: Still Field
pillars_supported: Synergy;Counterplay;Readable;Alien and unusual;Player skill;Felt immediately;Draft tension
what_it_does: A hit creates a freezing zone for a few seconds. Everything inside is held still. Your bullets leaving it gain speed and damage.
built_up: Bullets leave it faster and harder
deliberate_weakness: Timing matters; zone also freezes your shots

name: Brood Seed
pillars_supported: Synergy;Counterplay;Readable;Alien and unusual;Power fantasy;Felt immediately;Draft tension
what_it_does: Each kill has a chance to hatch a small drone that chases and bites enemies for 6 seconds.
with_one_stack: Kills may hatch a drone that bites for 6 seconds
built_up: Swarms of drones carry on-hit effects and feed kill counters
deliberate_weakness: Little use against a lone boss

name: Orbit Shard
what_it_does: Every 5th bullet orbits you for 5 seconds as a shield that damages enemies on contact.
with_one_stack: Every 5th bullet orbits you as a shield for 5 seconds
built_up: Constant shield that also damages on contact
deliberate_weakness: Each orbiting bullet is one less fired at enemies

name: Fault Line
pillars_supported: Synergy;Readable;Alien and unusual;Player skill;Power fantasy;Felt immediately
what_it_does: A bullet's path cracks the ground. After 1.5 seconds the crack erupts and damages everything on it.
with_one_stack: A bullet path cracks and erupts after 1.5 seconds
built_up: Long cracks through crowds erupt together
deliberate_weakness: Needs enemies to stay on the line

name: Heat Coil
pillars_supported: Synergy;Readable;Alien and unusual;Player skill;Power fantasy;Draft tension
what_it_does: Each pull builds heat. At full heat the next pull fires one huge piercing beam instead of normal bullets then heat resets.
with_one_stack: Heat builds with each pull; full heat fires a huge piercing beam
built_up: Rhythm of build-up and release
deliberate_weakness: The beam is one bullet so Split gains nothing; first beam takes 5-10 seconds

name: Adaptive Round
what_it_does: Bullets do bonus damage to the species you have hit most this level. Resets each level.
with_one_stack: Bonus damage vs the species you hit most this level (slow to build)
built_up: Strong in single-species levels; resets each level
deliberate_weakness: Weak in mixed levels; not felt at once
